questions.question: Policy vs mechanism?
options: Policy picks who runs; mechanism (switch) runs them
questions.explanation: Scheduler decides order; context switch performs it.

questions.question: FIFO completions for P1(0,8) P2(1,4) P3(2,2)?
questions.explanation: Arrival order, no preemption: P1 0-8, P2 8-12, P3 12-14.

questions.question: SJF (nonpreemptive) order here?
questions.explanation: P1 only choice at 0; at 8, shorter P3 beats P2.

questions.question: Turnaround vs waiting?
questions.explanation: Waiting isolates queue pain from service time.

questions.question: Why does SJF win averages here?
RR quantum trades?
options: Small q: better response, more switches; big q: approx FIFO
